notes.title: 🛠️ Post-Launch Hotfix Now Live – Patch Note
notes.notes:
Hello Renovators! 👷‍♂️🏀🥊

We've just rolled out a quick [b]post-launch hotfix[/b] to smooth out a few rough edges and improve your gameplay experience. Thank you for all your feedback and support so far, it helps us make the game better with each update!

[h2][b]🔧 Patch Notes – Hotfix Includes:[/b][/h2]

[list]
[*] Fixed painting issue on the American Football level

[*] Resolved issue with Baseball side quests

[*] Added separate saves at the start of each level to prevent blockers

[*] Updated Credits list
[/list]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2230960/Sports_Renovations/

🚀 Get [b]Sports: Renovations now[/b] and [b]start building your dream sports world[/b]! Ah, by the way, don't forget to join our community on [url=https://discord.gg/gD366rpY]Discord[/url]! :D

notes.title: Sports: Renovations - Release Date ⚽
notes.notes:
Hello guys! 

[b]Sports: Renovations is coming on March 27th, 2025 to Steam[/b]! 🎉  

Watch the brand [b]new Gameplay Trailer[/b] below!

[previewyoutube=yfU2BjKMeAI;full][/previewyoutube]

Restore sports facilities to their former glory in this relaxing story-driven simulator! 🏀✨
 
🧹 [b]Immerse yourself in a wholesome storyline[/b]
Your hometown basketball court may be demolished! Grab your tools, roll up your sleeves and breathe some life into other old sports facilities to earn money and save it!
 
🛠️ [b]Renovate dilapidated sports facilities[/b]
Collect trash, clean up the dirt, give the place a fresh coat of paint, fix broken fixtures and decorate the place. Remember to take a photo before and after!
 
⬆️ [b]Buy new tools and upgrade your equipment [/b]
Use the money you earn to upgrade your equipment and expand your headquarters – each unlocked room comes with its perks and sometimes a little side quest...
 
👉 [b]Join the Community on Discord[/b]
Don't miss out on any news by joining the official server: https://discord.gg/dnARB3F6qS
